name: rapidxml
input_api: rapidxml::xml_document<>::parse<0>(char*) on a mutable, zero-terminated local byte buffer
family_note: Own header-only parser. Boost.PropertyTree embeds a RapidXML-derived reader and is not an independent parser engine. Adapter resolves XML namespace prefixes from parsed xmlns attributes.
scope: XML UTF-8 on local mutable, zero-terminated buffers up to 1 MiB, with namespace resolution in the adapter. No validation or DTD expansion claim.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon installations of the library's -dev package (by_inst)
popularity.caveat: Only 17 installations and zero recent-use votes; the metric measures the dedicated Debian development package, not use of RapidXML embedded in Boost or vendored copies.
